name: set_variable_step examples
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises set_variable_step's three value_type coercions and only_if_unset, then reuses the resulting variables in a later step's config (${ticket_id}/${region}/${priority}) the same way date_step's output_var is reused - config resolution happens once per step against the full workflow context (workflow.py's resolve_config), not just inside the setting step. 'ticket_id' is set from ${email_subject} (string, the default value_type), 'region' is set to 'eu' with only_if_unset=true (no earlier step already set 'region' here, so it takes effect - only_if_unset matters more when a run_option pre-seeds the same key), and 'priority' is coerced to an integer so downstream arithmetic/formatting sees a real int rather than the string '1'. Use with example-data/emails/priority_ticket.eml (Subject: 'Priority Ticket #77 - region eu' -> ticket_id resolves to that subject; attachment saved under ./out/set-variable-examples/eu/P1-ticket-note.txt).
